newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Eight Sri Lankan troops missing after rebel raid.
newsitem.headline: Eight Sri Lankan troops missing after rebel raid.

text.p: One Sri Lankan sailor was killed and eight servicemen were missing after an attack by Tamil Tiger rebel boats in the waters off northwestern Mannar Island on Thursday, military officials said.
Rebel Sea Tiger naval wing boats, including two water-jet propelled craft, attacked a group of navy boats taking military personnel on leave, they said.
"One navy boat with about eight people on board is missing," said a navy spokesman. "One sailor was killed in the fighting."
The raid took place off Pesalai on Mannar Island, about 240 km (150 miles) north of the capital Colombo.
Casualties among Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam rebels, fighting for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the Indian Ocean island's north and east, were not immediately known.
The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the war, now in its 14th year. The rebels say the toll is higher.
